Welcome! This blog is where UBC Mathematics summer research assistants document and share their work.

## What Is This Blog For?

Each of you will write at least one blog post describing your research project. Posts can cover:

- The mathematical background and motivation
- Methods and techniques you are using
- Interesting results or visualizations
- Open questions you are exploring

Posts are written in [Quarto](https://quarto.org), which lets you mix prose, mathematics, and executable code (R or Python) in a single document.

## Getting Started

Read the **[How to Contribute](../how-to-contribute/index.qmd)** post for step-by-step instructions on setting up Quarto, creating your first post, and submitting it for review.

If you have any questions, reach out at [riddhi.battu@ubc.ca](mailto:riddhi.battu@ubc.ca).

Good luck with your research this summer!
